discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer product page, exact model/SKU, current listing price and primary specifications
discovery.result: The ABC Tech product page identifies ABC TECH X8 Study Buddy Tablet, SKU X8-CB-8I-232, current listed price PHP 4,899, 8-inch display, 2GB RAM, 32GB storage, 9863 octa-core solution, Android 12, 800×1280 TN/IPS display, GPS, 5MP front camera, 8MP rear camera, 4000mAh battery and 195×120mm body dimensions (thickness not given). Add-to-cart is shown; stock/checkout was not confirmed.

discovery.source_kind: Official brand identity, catalog and Philippine selling channels
discovery.result: Official site advertises ABC TECH X8 with an 8-inch IPS display, 2GB+32GB and 4000mAh; lists the X8 at PHP 4,899 and offers delivery to NCR, Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. The site's second product description says TN/IPS, so display type remains unresolved.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer-published Philippine product launch and launch configuration
discovery.result: Company blog dated 2023-07-28 says ABC Tech released its X8, X10 and X10 Plus tablet line on July 28. It identifies X8 as 8 inches, 32GB storage, 8MP rear and 5MP front camera. It is a company-hosted launch story authored by MB TechNews.

discovery.source_kind: Contemporaneous Philippine price and technical cross-check
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-08-15 reports the X8 at PHP 5,999, 8-inch IPS panel, 1920×1200 resolution, UNISOC SC9863, 2GB/32GB, 4000mAh with 10W charge, Android 12, Wi-Fi 4, 4G LTE, Bluetooth 5.0, dual SIM, USB-C, headphone jack and listed sensors. Its reported pixel resolution conflicts with the manufacturer's current 800×1280 product description.

discovery.source_kind: Independent Philippine launch, configuration and price cross-check
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-08-01 reports the ABC Tech X8 at 8 inches, IPS, 2GB/32GB, Android 12, 4000mAh, 8MP rear, 5MP front and PHP 5,999. It does not publish exact display pixels or a model SKU.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine launch story and exact camera/configuration cross-check
discovery.result: Article dated 2023-07-30 identifies ABC Tech Ventures Inc. and the X8 as its newly launched 8-inch, 32GB tablet with 8MP rear and 5MP front camera. It does not provide a model SKU or full hardware table.

discovery.source_kind: Independent company and Philippine-market identity verification
discovery.result: Philstar's 2023-05-19 profile identifies ABC Tech Ventures, its tablet business and Philippine educational-market activity. It says the brand planned a July release of its then-new general-public tablet line. This company-level coverage does not independently specify the X8 hardware.

UNISOC's official SC9863A page lists an octa-core Cortex-A55 CPU up to 1.6GHz, 28nm process options, PowerVR GE8322 GPU, LPDDR3/LPDDR4X support, eMMC 5.1 support, LTE, GNSS, Wi-Fi b/g/n and Bluetooth 4.2. These are component capabilities, not proof that every option or radio is configured in the X8.

prices.excerpt: GIZGUIDE reports the ABC TECH X8 at PHP 5,999 in its 2023 Philippine launch/specification coverage; Unbox Diaries independently reports the same launch price.
ABC Tech's exact SKU X8-CB-8I-232 product page lists PHP 4,899 and shows Add to Cart on 2026-11-27; stock/checkout was not verified.
